expects.rule: The phone number is a tap-to-call link in the header of every page, next to the booking button.
A veterinary practice states what to do in an emergency and out of hours: the number to call and the after-hours clinic, with its address.
Opening hours are listed day by day, every day labelled, with holiday closures.
Online booking or an appointment request is one button away, and says which species and services can be booked online.
Grooming, boarding, daycare and walking prices are published, by size or duration; vets publish at least consultation and vaccination prices or a clear statement of how costs are given.
The team is shown with names, roles and qualifications, and photos of the real premises.
Species treated, service area (for mobile grooming, pet sitting) and parking or access are stated.

traits: 4 of 6 sites read put a booking or appointment button in the header (Don't Board Me, Kindred, Folsom Ranch, My Dog Company); Folsom's goes to the contact page, Kindred's and My Dog Company's to external booking tools.
Only the 2 non-medical services publish prices (Don't Board Me from $30 a walk and monthly plans; My Dog Company CHF 29 an hour, 69 a half day, 99 a day); none of the 3 vets do.
4 of 6 give opening hours (Folsom 8am-8pm seven days, Kindred clinic hours, Kireys Mon-Sat 9-5, My Dog Company drop-off and pick-up times); Kindred's first set of hours has unlabelled days.
1 of 3 veterinary sites has an urgent-care page and an after-hours hospitals page (Folsom Ranch); Kindred and Doutor Mauro state nothing on emergencies.
4 of 6 show customer reviews or testimonials on the page (Folsom 23 five-star reviews, Kireys, Don't Board Me, Doutor Mauro); Kindred only links to Yelp.
2 of 6 use illustration rather than photography as the main visual (Kindred animated pet illustrations, Don't Board Me with a loading-screen ball game).

sites.name: Don't Board Me
sites.why: In-home pet sitting and dog walking in San Diego-Carlsbad: headline 'A tired dog is a happy dog!', Book in the header, Book now repeated, three priced walking plans (single 30-minute walk from $30, twice a week $224/month, three times $312/month marked most popular), four numbered steps to a first 'Welcome Woof' meeting, phone with WhatsApp link, ten testimonials, Instagram photo grid.

sites.name: Kindred Pet Care
sites.why: Veterinary practice in St. Charles, Illinois: headline 'Expertise meets compassion at Kindred Pet Care', Request an Appointment in the header (external booking), tap-to-call phone and address, service cards (preventive care, surgery, dental, pet drop-off), wellness plans with a Choose a plan button, four team headshots with names, animated pet illustrations. Hours partly unlabelled; no emergency information.

sites.name: My Dog Company
sites.why: Dog daycare, grooming and overnight care in Zürich, three addresses (one for sausage dogs only): banner 'enrichment based dog daycare, custom grooming, exclusive holiday & overnight care', menu spa / daycare / membership / booking, prices in CHF (29 an hour, 69 a half day, 99 a full day), drop-off from 7:30 and pick-up 4:15-6:30, external booking. No phone number on the page.

sites.name: Folsom Ranch Veterinary Hospital
sites.why: Privately owned vet in Folsom, California: 'General Practice & Urgent Care', 'open 7 days a week', 'Always Accepting New Patients', Book an appointment and Contact us in the header, click-to-call (916) 936-1130, hours 8am-8pm, street address, Urgent Care and After Hour Hospitals pages, 23 named five-star reviews, a hiring banner.

sites.name: Kirey's Pet Salon & Hotel
sites.why: Grooming salon, mobile grooming van, pet hotel and pet taxi in Mission, Texas: headline 'Taking Care Of Your Pets As If They Were Our Own', four service icons, phone, address, hours Mon-Sat 9-5 closed Sunday, a list of eleven towns served, 'Hablamos Español!'. No prices or booking form, and template copy ('Insert a video that shows the benefits...') left on the page.

sites.name: Clínica Veterinária Doutor Mauro
sites.why: Small-animal vet in João Pessoa, Brazil, in Portuguese: headline 'Buscamos a excelência' under the vet's name, six-item menu (clinic, testimonials, facilities, services, location, contact), two landline numbers, street address with a See map button, testimonials, the vet's specialities (dermatology, surgery, traumatology). No hours; the phone icon links to '#'.

avoid: A veterinary site with no emergency or out-of-hours instructions.
A phone icon that links to '#' instead of a tel: link.
Opening hours listed without the day each line belongs to.
Template text left on the page ('Insert a video that shows...').
A booking button that only leads to a generic contact form with no sign of available slots.
Grooming or boarding with 'contact us for prices' and no from-price by dog size.
A domain that now redirects to another business without notice.
